source.title: [C06 p5a] Define roles, committees and sourcing choices lesson
source.body:
Parent: #20. Task p5a; objective obj-p5a-1: Design an operating model with roles, committees, sourcing and an awareness intervention.

Required artifact: Define roles, committees and sourcing choices. Criteria: Explain accountability and supplier oversight; Define one culture outcome and ethical escalation channel. Preserve actual C01 prerequisites and mapping limitations.

Deliver a substantial original self-contained lesson, two executive worked examples, misconceptions, practical exercise/scoped rubric, at least3 curated cards and5 questions (2 MCQ,2 scenario,1 open). Explain every option; constructed prompts/models/anchors assess the same requested work. Plain precise scientific English; inspect official primary sources and version/rights metadata. No unsupported ISO/framework/legal/certification claim.

Add docs/curriculum/drafts/p5a.json plus brief evidence guide, then register exact source commit/hash in the provisional manifest. Preserve every previously delivered revision/actor/editorial/reference and all37 tasks/six scores/v1v2 formats. Provisional AI-authored status stays explicit; qualified human educator/legal gates remain unchanged.

C02 previous-reference/hash equality, unit/type/build and focused local new-content/Pages flows pass; no browserCI. Each task has a fresh implementation agent and separate fresh Astra exact-candidate review; two-Changes-requested cap. Approved PR is merged and usable. AGENTS.md, MEMORY/PLAN and C02 contract apply; record product decisions or explicitly state unchanged.
